data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE env var eliminated (GREEN phase)
- DD4: merge-to-main-pr.sh and merge-to-main-direct.sh operate without MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE (GREEN phase)

## Implementation
This task is ATOMIC — both files must be committed together because they share the MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE env var contract. Splitting would leave one file reading an env var the other no longer sets.

**In `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh`:**
- Remove `export MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE=1` (line ~2165)
- Remove `unset MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE` (line ~2167)
- No replacement needed — merge-to-main-direct.sh will read dso.workflow directly

**In `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-direct.sh`:**
- Replace `if [[ "${MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE:-}" == "1" ]]; then` in _phase_version_bump
- New condition: read `dso.workflow` via `bash "$_SCRIPT_DIR/read-config.sh" dso.workflow 2>/dev/null`
  If `dso.workflow=ci-pr`, use new-commit strategy (same as old MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE=1 path)
  Otherwise, use amend strategy (same as old else path)
- WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE can be set for test isolation (already supported by read-config.sh)

Justification for atomic task (Gate 2): committing only the removal in merge-to-main-pr.sh would leave
merge-to-main-direct.sh still reading MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE (which would now be unset), silently
taking the amend path even in PR mode — broken intermediate state.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh && bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] merge-to-main-pr.sh no longer exports MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE
  Verify: ! grep -q 'export MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] merge-to-main-direct.sh no longer reads MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE
  Verify: ! grep -q 'MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-direct.sh
- [ ] merge-to-main-direct.sh reads dso.workflow for version bump strategy
  Verify: grep -q 'dso\.workflow' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-direct.sh
- [ ] RED markers removed from .test-index
  Verify: ! grep '\[test_version_bump_uses_dso_workflow' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Implement: eliminate MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE env var from merge-to-main-pr.sh and merge-to-main-direct.sh
